thread.title: Universal Display stock rises after Gabelli analyst upgrades to buy, dismisses Apple MicroLED concerns

title: Universal Display stock rises after Gabelli analyst upgrades to buy, dismisses Apple MicroLED concerns

organizations.name: emily bary  shares of universal display corp

text:
12:20 p.m. ET Share 
By Emily Bary 
Shares of Universal Display Corp. OLED, +5.92% are up 4.4% in Tuesday trading after Gabelli analyst Hendi Susanto upgraded the stock to buy from hold. His upgrade comes after the stock plunged 12% in Monday's session, following a report saying Apple Inc. AAPL, +0.09% was making its own MicroLED display screens . Susanto wrote in his upgrade note that he thought Apple's work with MicroLED screens was still in the research and development stage, and he noted that Apple bought a MicroLED startup in 2014, meaning that the company's interest in the technology isn't particularly new. "The commercialization is at least a couple of years away," Susanto wrote of Apple's MicroLED efforts. Meanwhile, he sees "more upside potential than downside risks" for Universal Display, which makes OLED screens. Susanto pointed to a "multiyear investment in OLED display capacity" from many global players as well as management's own forecast for a sharp increase in the number of installed OLED screens through 2019. Universal Display stock is up 33% over the past 12 months, while the S&P 500 SPX, +0.10% is up 14%. Quote References
